title: Flat decompositions with vanishing masses give pointwise convergence of the differences
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set. For k ∈ ℕ let X_k, Pc_k, S_k ∈ D_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and R_k ∈ D_{n+1}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (n+1)). Assume X_k(ω) − Pc_k(ω) = ∂R_k(ω) + S_k(ω) for every k ∈ ℕ and every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U). Assume also M(R_k) → 0 and M(S_k) → 0 in [0, ∞] as k → ∞, where M(·) = mass = M_U(·). Then Pc_k(ω) − X_k(ω) → 0 as k → ∞ for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X Pc S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), X k ω - Pc k ω = (R k).boundary ω + S k ω) → Tendsto (fun k => (R k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun k => (S k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun k => Pc k ω - X k ω) atTop (𝓝 0)
